policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV says 'Jesus said unto him' without 'answered,' distinguishing the base reading from the added ἀποκριθείς.
ASV explicitly has 'left here,' representing ὧδε and excluding its omission.
ASV 'one stone upon another' does not distinguish the accusative λίθον from the dative λίθῳ; the base fallback is retained.
ASV makes the coordinated four disciples the plural subject of 'asked,' distinguishing plural ἐπηρώτων from singular ἐπηρώτα.
ASV says 'these things are all about to be accomplished,' preserving the base order with 'these things' before 'all.'
ASV has 'Jesus began to say unto them' and no 'answered,' distinguishing the base reading from the added ἀποκριθείς.
ASV begins simply 'Many shall come' with no causal 'for,' excluding the added γάρ.
ASV's future formulation 'when ye shall hear' distinguishes the base ἀκούσητε from ἀκούετε.
ASV says 'these things must needs come to pass' without a causal 'for' at this clause, excluding the added γάρ.
ASV begins the earthquake clause 'there shall be' after a semicolon, with no added 'and,' distinguishing the base reading.
ASV begins the famine clause 'there shall be' after a semicolon, with no added 'and,' distinguishing the base reading.
ASV mentions famines but no 'troubles,' excluding the added καὶ ταραχαί.
ASV has singular 'the beginning of travail,' distinguishing singular ἀρχή from plural ἀρχαί.
ASV explicitly says 'for they shall deliver you up,' representing the added γάρ.
ASV order 'must first be preached' matches δεῖ πρῶτον rather than the base πρῶτον δεῖ.
ASV 'And when' permits both καὶ ὅταν and connective δέ rendered as 'and'; the unrelated note does not decide the unit, so the base fallback is retained.
ASV uses 'lead you,' directly distinguishing ἄγωσιν from ἀγάγωσιν ('bring').
ASV gives only 'be not anxious beforehand what ye shall speak' and has no additional prohibition against rehearsing or meditating, excluding μηδὲ μελετᾶτε.
ASV initial 'And' can represent either καί or connective δέ, and the verse notes do not decide this unit; the base fallback is retained.
ASV has 'the abomination of desolation standing' but does not include 'spoken by Daniel the prophet,' excluding r01.
ASV's verse-linking 'and' may be supplied in English or render δέ; it does not require the added δέ, so the base fallback is retained.
ASV says 'not go down, nor enter in' and does not attach 'into the house' to 'go down,' excluding the added εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν.
ASV order 'to take anything' matches ἆραί τι rather than base τι ἆραι.
ASV 'him that is in the field' can render either the substantival phrase or the same phrase with explicit ὤν; the base fallback is retained.
ASV says only 'that it be not in the winter' and does not name 'your flight,' excluding the added ἡ φυγὴ ὑμῶν.
ASV's idiom 'such as there hath not been the like' does not distinguish ἣν from ἧς; the base fallback is retained.
ASV order 'the Lord had shortened' places the subject before the verb, matching κύριος ἐκολόβωσεν.
ASV explicitly begins 'And then,' representing καί and excluding its omission.
ASV 'Lo' can render either Ἴδε or Ἰδού; the alternative-rendering note cannot decide a reading, so the base fallback is retained.
ASV explicitly has 'or, Lo, there,' representing the added ἤ.
ASV's second 'Lo' can render either Ἴδε or Ἰδού; the alternative-rendering note cannot decide a reading, so the base fallback is retained.
ASV says 'if possible, the elect' without 'even/also,' excluding the added καί.
ASV explicitly includes 'behold, I have told you,' representing added ἰδού.
ASV's periphrastic 'shall be falling from heaven' matches ἔσονται ... πίπτοντες in the base reading.
ASV says 'the angels,' not 'his angels,' excluding added αὐτοῦ.
ASV explicitly says 'his elect,' representing added αὐτοῦ.
ASV naturalizes the phrase as 'her branch is now become tender' and does not preserve either Greek placement closely enough to distinguish the transposition; the base fallback is retained.
ASV order 'when ye see these things' matches ἴδητε ταῦτα; the alternative-rendering note concerns 'he/it' and does not affect this unit.
ASV order 'all these things' matches πάντα ταῦτα rather than base ταῦτα πάντα.
ASV uses plural 'Heaven and earth shall pass away,' distinguishing plural παρελεύσονται from singular παρελεύσεται.
ASV 'shall not pass away' permits both the strengthened οὐ μή construction and simple οὐ with μή omitted; the base fallback is retained.
ASV 'shall not pass away' can render either future παρελεύσονται or aorist subjunctive παρέλθωσιν in the negative construction; the base fallback is retained.
ASV 'that day or that hour' does not determine whether the Greek article is repeated before 'hour'; the base fallback is retained.
ASV 'the angels in heaven' permits both ἐν and the articular phrase οἱ ἐν; the base fallback is retained.
ASV text includes 'watch and pray,' representing added καὶ προσεύχεσθε; the mapped textual-variant note explicitly reports that some authorities omit those words.
ASV has 'given authority to his servants, to each one his work' without an added conjunction before 'to each one,' distinguishing the base reading; the Greek-gloss note is unrelated.
ASV explicitly has 'or at midnight' in the sequence, representing ἤ and excluding its omission.
ASV 'at midnight' does not distinguish μεσονύκτιον from genitive μεσονυκτίου; the base fallback is retained.
ASV 'what I say' can represent either singular ὃ or plural ἅ without an overt English number distinction; the base fallback is retained.
